retrievalProfile.description: A centered, highly ornate calligraphic script with extensive flourishes set against a high-resolution woven canvas texture.

recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated composition featuring a central block of intricate, dark-inked calligraphy with dramatic swashes and loops, positioned over a neutral-toned, tightly woven textile surface with a subtle horizontal seam or color shift in the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark ink script contrasting against light cream textile
Complex organic curves of lettering against a rigid geometric grid of fabric
Secondary clean sans-serif text balancing the ornate primary script
Horizontal division in the background providing a stable base for the floating text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary script is centered and occupies approximately 60% of the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dense, dark blue-black ink of the central calligraphy.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the fluid, sweeping curves of the script from top-left to bottom-right, then drops to the secondary metadata line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the central text block to emphasize the texture of the canvas.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the background and the foreground ink.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and deep inks

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with extreme contrast
Ascenders and descenders transition into long, looping flourishes
Letters are tightly kerned and often physically interlock
Terminals end in sharp points or elegant teardrop bulbs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'Y' features a massive sweeping tail that underlines the word
Lowercase 'g' and 'h' have extended loops that fill negative space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative script paired with a wide-tracked, minimalist geometric sans-serif for legibility and balance.

avoid: Standard cursive fonts without custom flourishes

candidateDirections.reason: Provides a similar formal copperplate foundation with extensive glyph variants.
For the secondary metadata text to match the wide, clean aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution, macro-view texture of a light cream woven canvas. Include a subtle horizontal seam or color break in the lower third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary calligraphic text in a dark navy ink, ensuring the flourishes interlock and fill the central space. Add the secondary all-caps metadata in a deep red with wide tracking in the bottom right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the canvas texture visible through the ink?
Are the flourishes of the script interlocking without becoming illegible?
Is the secondary text properly aligned to the right?
Is the color palette restricted to cream, navy, and deep red?

mustRedesign: Do not use flat white backgrounds; must have textile texture
Ensure swashes are hand-drawn in appearance, not mechanical
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the script is the dominant visual element.
Check that the canvas texture is consistent across the frame.
Verify the wide tracking of the secondary sans-serif text.
Ensure the flourishes do not obscure the primary word forms.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ornate [Script Style] calligraphy + [Textile Type] texture background + [Wide-tracked Sans-Serif] metadata.
